sources.title: Granite Embedding - IBM
sources.snippet: The Granite Embedding model collection consists of embedding models to generate high-quality text embeddings and a reranker model to improve the relevance and quality of search results or recommendations.

sources.title: ibm-granite/granite-embedding-107m-multilingual · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Summary:Granite-Embedding-107M-Multilingual is a 107M parameter dense biencoder embedding model from the Granite Embeddings suite that can be used to generate high quality text embeddings. sources.title: arXiv:2502.20204v1 [cs.IR] 27 Feb 2025
sources.snippet: We release five high performing base-sized models, granite-embedding-125m-english and granite-embedding-278m-multilingual, as well as smaller, faster counterparts, granite-embedding-30m-english, granite-embedding-107m-multilingual and granite-embedding-30m-sparse suitable for di-verse resource and latency budgets.
